description:
Check an OCR job you queued with `ocr_pdf`.

Returns `job_id` and `status` (`queued`, `running`, `succeeded` or
`failed`). A succeeded job includes `download_url`, a link to the
searchable PDF that works for 60 minutes without an API key: give it
to the user. A failed job includes `error` (one sentence) and `code`.
Results are deleted 7 days after submission. Requires an API key.

Credits: free. This tool is not metered.
name: get_ocr_result
title: Check an OCR job
